in_hebrew.name: עשואל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Ashwell does not have a direct translation in Hebrew. It may be derived from Old English 'Æscwealh' or 'Ascwealh', which means 'ash tree hollow'. The Hebrew name closest in meaning might be 'El-Ohel' (God of the tabernacle).

in_greek.name: Ασχολιος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Ashwell does not have a direct translation in Greek. It may be derived from Old English 'Æscwealh' or 'Ascwealh', which means 'ash tree hollow'. In Greek, a similar meaning could be 'Asclepios' (God of healing), as the ash tree was considered sacred in ancient Greek culture.

in_latin.name: Asculus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Ashwell does not have a direct translation in Latin. It may be derived from Old English 'Æscwealh' or 'Ascwealh', which means 'ash tree hollow'. In Latin, a similar meaning could be 'Quercus' (oak tree), as the ash tree was also considered sacred in Roman culture.
